entry.title: PSX Verb 0.5.3
entry.summary: PlayStation 1 SPU reverb emulation. Port of the Schwung module **PSX Verb** by charlesvestal to the MPC/Force plugin host, compiled unchanged from `charlesvestal/schwung-psxverb` at `c8cc0423807c` (`MIT`), linked with the mpc-vst-plugins VST2 wrapper and this repository's Schwung adapter `adapters/schwungfx/`.
